summary: Well-executed, reproducible preregistered paired study that quantifies the marginal effect of a verifier-triggered repair under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Artifacts and accounting appear complete and consistent; the paper appropriately bounds conclusions given the synthetic task bank, single model, and shared-initial design. Statistical power was undermined by an unexpectedly high baseline pass rate, limiting inferential strength.
optional_revisions: In Results or Methods, add one brief sentence giving the exact binomial calculation used by the reported exact two-sided McNemar implementation (to aid reproducibility of the p=1.0 statement).

In Discussion, explicitly state (one short sentence) that the primary estimand measures the marginal effect of verifier/repair under shared_initial_candidate semantics (i.e., repair-only effect) so readers cannot generalize to independent first-pass generation contrasts without new experiments.

Confirm in the final manuscript that References are presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography (full bibliographic metadata) and that the archived BibTeX file matches the printed reference list.
